name: Kin Hold'em
purpose: Texas Hold'em for play chips. Free Solo vs computer players runs on screen with no credits. Or host a table for up to 5 people, or seat your Kins (uses Kindroid credits).

actions.name: wake
actions.description: Open Kin Hold'em and see how the poker table stands: hands, chips and whose turn it is. Use when the person wants to play poker or asks how the game is going.
